title: Andhra Pradesh & Telangana heatwave, May 2015
context: One of India's deadliest heatwaves, concentrated in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
source: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive; alerts computed by the live rules
note: Real historical periods replayed through the live index and alert code using ERA5 reanalysis (Open-Meteo archive). ERA5 is a ~25 km grid, so peak values run a few degrees below station records.
